usedFor: StoreHippo holds shop users, and Loops.so receives each new user through “Create a contact in mailing list” after “New User”.

bestTemplate.name: “New User” in StoreHippo, then “Create a contact in mailing list” in Loops.so
bestTemplate.why: A new shop user joins your Loops.so mailing list, so email starts without a manual import.

watchOut: “User Updated” also fires in StoreHippo, so the same user can reach “Create a contact in mailing list” again.
